tools.name: search_documentation
tools.description: Find official instructions for connecting the MCP server, querying the API, using the SDK or CLI, authentication, and travel-power lookup safety. Returns document IDs, URLs and excerpts; use read_documentation for the full document.

tools.name: read_documentation
tools.description: Read a complete official document by the ID returned by search_documentation. Includes overview, API/MCP/SDK reference, authentication policy and the travel-power workflow. Does not fetch arbitrary URLs.
